name: SLAMPUNKS
description:
About This Game

LINK UP OR GET SMASHED

Launch a teammate into the horde, then detonate your own combo the second they land. Get it right and your build goes feral. Get greedy and the whole squad busts. Solo runs hit hard on their own. Add a friend and you start breaking the game together.

KEY FEATURES

  • 🎮 Hero-based, ability-driven combat: no auto-fire, every hero plays like a different game

  • 🤝 Squad-as-weapon combat: tether, launch, and steamroll with your friends

  • 🎥 Switch camera between top-down and third-person mid-run, no penalty

  • 💥 Heist runs with randomized objectives, not fixed levels

  • 🧬 Augments that mutate your abilities, unlocking new paths for chaos

PICK YOUR PUNK

Kitsune, who grapples a teammate and spins into a lethal energy chain; Chonk, who can outgrow the screen and steamroll through everything (including friends); Frill, whose guitar solo swaps between a healing chord and a wall of sound; plus Bonk and Fryball, each hiding a twist of their own. Five heroes at launch. More landing during Early Access.

ROB THE CORPS

Every 30-minute run is a heist with randomized jobs with unlockable modifiers for punks seeking more thrill.

  • Sabotage: smash massive mining rigs into scrap.

  • Escort: push hijacked payloads through endless security bots.

  • Hunt: track elite enforcers and tear the loot out of them.

BREAK THE SCREEN

Finishing objectives unlocks augments built to be pushed too far. Stack them until your build spirals out of control. More power, more chaos, one bad pull from losing everything.

RETOOL BETWEEN RUNS

Make it out with stolen resources and spend them at The Armory. Get a perma-boost, get meaner. You'll die in a fireball. You'll come back louder.

WHAT'S HERE AT LAUNCH

  • 5 heroes, more landing during Early Access

  • 3 heist job types, randomized every run

  • 78+ augments

  • 100+ stackable stat upgrades

  • 3 difficulties, unlockable as you go, plus Prestige tiers once you've cleared them

  • 12 run modifiers

  • 1 map: Silverstone Quarry

  • 1 enemy faction: the Kreel, an insect-like hive species pressed into the fight

JOIN THE RIOT

Made by two people who want more action in their action-roguelites. We hang in the Discord every week. Bring your dumbest co-op combo.
short_desc: SLAMPUNKS is a 1-3 player co-op hero-based survivors-like. You're an unhinged rebel sabotaging the corp draining the planet dry. Pick a hero, tether your friend, and use them to steamroll the swarm. Stack game-breaking augments until they beg for mercy. Bullet heaven, where your buddy is the weapon.
